race.description: The Posthouse Motel Goulburn 3yo Mdn  Pace
race.comment: OUR ULTIMATE ELSIE NZ (1) finished second at her last run just three days ago over 1740m at Riverina Paceway, beaten 18 metres. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. Meeting a deeper field this time but she is up to the challenge. DOUBLE ACCORD (9) was in the money at Newcastle two runs ago before finishing eighth at his latest appearance over 1609m at Newcastle, beaten 19 metres. Can settle just behind them and wait on the sprint lane. His last run should be overlooked. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. DOUBLE HIGH (6) was responsible for a better effort last time out when runner-up over 1609m at Newcastle. Should run a big race. BROOKLYNS GEM (2) draws for a good showing.
